Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the acquisition details by conflating the acquired UK label (Oriole Records) with the post-acquisition renamed entity (CBS Records UK). Despite sources stating CBS bought Oriole Records in 1964 (with UK distribution under CBS beginning in 1965), the Planner incorrectly asserted that the label purchased was “CBS Records (UK),” mixing up acquisition with subsequent rebranding.
